title: A position rename leaves every installed organization's holders behind: nothing carries sys_user_position across it
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cx5PxdkxaGcUWo9HwY

Filing gate: ① a measured gap that already-landed platform work (ADR-0150 D7, objectstack#31669) creates for every app: it asks an app to rename its positions, and nothing carries the holders across the rename.
Business reason: an app that renames a position after go-live (HotCRM did all 12 for 18.4.0, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2437) leaves every installed organization's holders on a name that no longer exists, so those people silently lose the permission sets, sharing, approvals and queues the position grants until an administrator moves each assignment. HotCRM ships a per-organization script for it (objectstack-ai/hotcrm PR #2446, `scripts/migrate-position-holders.ts`), which a marketplace install cannot run by itself.
Reader who acts: triage (route and grade); then whichever lane owns position metadata / package upgrade.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue position rename holders`, `renamedFrom position`, `sys_user_position rename` (searched this act).

## Measured (read on objectstack main, by the hotcrm#2437 card thread)

- A holder is a `sys_user_position` row whose `position` column stores the position NAME (`plugin-security` `sys-user-position.object.ts`); ADR-0150 D8 row R2 keeps it a bare name.
- `PositionSchema` has no rename or alias key; the package upgrade plan's `renamedFrom` covers object fields only (`metadata-core` `package-upgrade-plan.ts`); there is no package install/upgrade hook an app could use; a flow or hook cannot write assignments as the system identity.
- The only supported path today is an administrator editing each assignment (the Setup write), per organization, after the renamed version is installed.

## Expected

A declared position rename (e.g. a `renamedFrom` on a position, applied by the package upgrade plan) moves the holders in the same upgrade, or the platform names its supported shape. Until then, every app that renames a position needs its own migration script.
